main_text.p: rūmque judicio. Et præter Cameronem, id vidit & observavit, nemo. Utut in ex-ordij formâ, & summâ rerum, consensum Petri cum Paulo non eamus inficias. Quàm verò illud sit jejunum, præter collationem antè institutam, docebunt sequentia. III Hoc etiam dato, laborat nihilo-minùs consequentia, & admittitur elen-chus parium. Priorem Petri, Pauli non esse constat vel ex inscriptione, sed Petri. Et quanquam hujus author latitaret, de-sunt rationes aliæ, præter affinitatem quandam argumenti, cur Pauli crederetur. Contrà, de Epistolæ ad Hebræos parente, res in obscuro est; rectè ergo ex fœtus illius lineamentis, patrem conjectamus. Imprimis, tot aliis conjectandi, imò certò pronunciandi rationibus ad-ducti, atque impulsi, prætermissis Cameroni ac dissimulatis.
XI. Excipient fortassis alij, per retor-sionis quendam modum. Quæ Epistola continet talia, quorum vestigium in Paulinis nullum, minimè ea Pauli esse videatur. Atqui istiusmodi, quæ habet author de

page.notes: Long s is printed as f in "confensum" and "fœtus"; transcribed here as s. The first word of the page ("rūmque") is partly obscured and is a fragment carried over from the previous page; the macron and the initial letter are uncertain. The line "vide-atur" has bold type on its final syllable, which is hard to read. The Roman numeral "III" is set in small capitals in the print. The last word of the page, "de", is the catchword.
